prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Path selection stage layout upgrades and waiting screen realtime progress timers significantly improved conversion.
Interactive walkthrough redesigns, home intro redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in reassurance hints, sign-in reordering, and path selection incentives significantly hurt conversion.
Copy changes, background notifications, photo upload guidance, and layout changes to sign-in, adoption, or story screens showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for path selection stage layout upgrades and waiting screen progress timers.
Predictions were too high for interactive walkthrough redesigns, home intro redesigns, new adoption flows, sign-in hints and reordering, and path selection incentives.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: -15.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.6% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, incentive: -8.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +6.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.3% over 3 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -10.3% over 4 test(s)
- home, notification: +0.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: -0.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.9% over 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Full Bleed Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a full-bleed visual layout with an animated video mascot component. (why: Story screen dropoff occurs early; stage layout upgrades worked well in choose_path previously.)
1: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Reassurance Hint: Add explicit hint text on the choose path screen clarifying that path selection can be changed later in settings. (why: Choose path takes a median 8s but mean 514s, indicating hesitation for some users.)
2: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Cloud Account Sync Reassurance: Display a account cloud sync badge and reassurance text on the sign-in screen. (why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Stage Layout Redesign: Upgrade the pick friend adoption screen layout to stage format with animated preview cards. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (60.9% conversion, median 89s), and stage layout upgrades yielded proven gains on choose_path.)
4: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Card Layout Upgrade: Switch upload photos screen to card layout with an explicit progress indicator. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Care Pledge New Screen: Insert a short interactive pet care pledge screen between photo upload and adoption certificate. (why: Building emotional connection before waiting step reduces drop-off during lengthier pet processing.)
6: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Stage Layout Upgrade: Upgrade waiting screen layout to stage layout with background generation animation. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Stage layout upgrades previously drove massive gains.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Audio Cue: Add a pleasant sound cue component to play when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Support receives 3 emails about pets not showing or users missing desktop spawn during long waits.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Spawn Active Headline: Update home_intro headline and body to explicitly announce that the pet is now active on screen. (why: Users are unsure if the pet has spawned on desktop after finishing setup.)
